documents.title: Proceeding Of 3Rd Annual General Meeting Held On 31 July 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores for FY26, representing a 12% growth over the previous financial year, driven primarily by its water technologies business. Management noted that while the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units, profitability faces immediate pressure from rising input and raw material costs. The company enters the new financial year with a strong order book in water chemicals and equipment, while continuing geographical expansion and tight working capital control. Chembond Chemicals Limited reported its business and financial performance updates for FY26 and H2 FY26.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive, though earnings profitability faces immediate challenges.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive. However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

guidance.claim: The company foresees 15% to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals for Q1 of the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth in water chemicals to be roughly around 10%.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

demand_outlook.claim: Demand pickup in fin cleaning is being driven by data centers and commercial buildings.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing some pickup in this segment, especially driven by a lot of data centers and commercial buildings having significantly large AHUs. in place.

demand_outlook.claim: Sealants are seeing significant growth, and the company intends to consolidate its presence using polysulfide and PU sealants.
demand_outlook.quote: Sealants, we are seeing a significant growth and we intend to consolidate our presence in that segment through our polysulfide and PU sealants.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees positive sales growth outlook supported by strong sales pipelines across all business units.
demand_outlook.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported a robust enquiry pipeline for the Water BU.
Activity in Construction Chemicals has picked up following the monsoon.

capex_expansion.claim: The full-year capex of around Rs. 21 crores reflects demerger effects including office building renovation and PPE recognition.
capex_expansion.quote: And of course, the office building, the improvements that we've done and the The entire renovation of the office building to house our teams, so that has taken up, but twenty-one crores, whole demerger, yeah, P.P.E. which has come into our books, so this is the demerger effect.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 350 kVA rooftop solar renewable energy plant at its Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.
capex_expansion.quote: A 350 kVA rooftop solar renewable energy plant was commissioned at the Dudhwada, Gujarat plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital investment towards the installation of the 350 kVA solar plant at Dudhwada was Rs 90.76 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Full year EBITDA grew 7% over the prior year to Rs. 51 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the full financial year is at Rs.51 crores, up 7% over prior.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 14% of sales, while profit after tax margin was 10% of sales for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: And in terms of percentage margin to sales, EBITDA is 14% of sales and profit after tax is 10% of sales.

margins_costs.claim: Margins improved due to lower raw material costs and newer product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies

orders_capacity.claim: Chembond started the new financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: The water BU entered the year with a strong order book for both chemicals and equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: Water BU, we are entering this, as I mentioned earlier, with a strong order book for chemicals as well as for the equipment.

orders_capacity.claim: The Water BU maintains a strong order book for specialty chemicals.
orders_capacity.quote: Strong order book for specialty chemicals

capital_allocation.claim: Management intends to deploy surplus funds towards network growth and geographical expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capital_allocation.claim: Days sales outstanding for construction chemicals stood at around 88 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs 1.25 per equity share aggregating to Rs 336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Material costs began increasing from late February and March due to metal price volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector units represent about 30% of the water business and have resisted contract term amendments during raw material price surges.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: Material costs increased due to war impact, alongside volatility in metal compounds.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to deploy surplus cash reserves towards expanding the company's network and geographic footprint.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
